name: Guided first-run setup
definition: Explains accounts, first transaction and first budget with optional sample data.

name: Setup checklist
definition: Dismissible checklist remains until essential setup is complete.

name: Unlimited local accounts
definition: Cash, bank, wallet, credit card and custom types.

name: Opening balance and adjustment history
definition: Adjustments require reason and preserve audit trail.

name: Income and expense records
definition: Fast entry with category, merchant, tags and note.

name: Split transactions
definition: One payment can be divided across categories.

name: Undo deletion and edit history
definition: Protects against accidental data loss.

name: Account transfers
definition: Atomic linked transfer that never counts as income or expense.

name: Transfer fees and cross-currency received amount
definition: Fee is recorded separately; received amount can differ.

name: Recurring transactions
definition: Automatic or reminder-first schedules.

name: Month-end and missed-run recovery
definition: Prevents skipped or duplicate monthly entries.

name: Monthly budgets that persist across months
definition: Each period is generated and calculated independently.

name: Weekly, yearly and custom-period budgets
definition: Custom start/end dates and repeat rules.

name: Carry-over modes
definition: Off, positive only, or full carry-over.

name: Six-month and yearly views
definition: Included in free core.

name: Custom date-range reports
definition: User chooses any inclusive range.

name: Day/week/month/quarter/all-time views
definition: Consistent period selector.

name: Calendar date navigation
definition: Jump directly to a date instead of tapping through every day.

name: Advanced combined filters
definition: Account, category, tag, amount, date, attachment and status.

name: Saved filters
definition: Store frequently used queries.

name: Receipt and document attachments
definition: Images, PDFs and documents attached to each transaction.

name: Attachment integrity scan
definition: Detects missing/corrupt files before backup.

name: Complete local backup
definition: Records, settings and attachments in one package.

name: User-selected cloud-drive folder via Android picker
definition: Allows recovery after uninstall without an app account or paid server.

name: Encrypted backup
definition: AES-GCM package protected by user passphrase.

name: Validated restore with preview and rollback
definition: Never replaces current data until integrity checks pass.

name: Reliable CSV export
definition: Streaming export with completion report and failure recovery.

name: Structured JSON export
definition: Complete portable representation excluding binary files.

name: CSV import template
definition: Preview, field mapping and duplicate handling.

name: Simple stable interface
definition: No feature regression or forced redesign without compatibility path.

name: Dark and light themes
definition: Accessible contrast and system mode.

name: Optional device-auth app lock
definition: Biometric/PIN delegated to Android.

name: No forced ads in critical flows
definition: No ads in add, edit, budget, backup or restore.

name: Core features never paywalled
definition: History, filters, reports, backup and restore remain free.

name: Advanced dashboard layouts
definition: Convenience/customisation only.

name: Advanced forecasting and comparison packs
definition: Optional analytical depth, not basic history.

name: Premium report themes and extra home widgets
definition: Cosmetic/convenience value.

name: Real-time multi-device sync
definition: Requires recurring infrastructure and privacy review.

name: Shared household ledger
definition: Built only after sync foundation is sustainable.
